text:
Mattias Ekholm, 36, is still playing 21 minutes a night on Edmonton's blue line, with 3 goals and 11 points in 24 games. The numbers around him are mixed and worth reading carefully.

The Oilers take 54.7% of the 5v5 attempts with him on the ice but only 49.8% of the expected goals, so the chances against are getting through. The goals have covered for it: Edmonton has scored 18.7 more goals than expected with him out there, and he has 3 goals on 1.35 expected. On-ice luck that large rarely holds.

He still has the tools. His top shot reaches 95.1 mph, 89th percentile in NHL Edge tracking, and last season Evolving-Hockey had him in the 98th percentile of defensemen for driving his team's chances, 49th among 215 at 1.4 wins above replacement.

The last ten games were quiet but fair: five points against 4.2 expected, with his one goal coming against Vancouver on Nov. 7. He came into the season with 966 career games, so 1,000 is close.
